expected_html:
flowchart TD
    subgraph Player["Player (User Browser)"]
        UClick["點擊行末「撤銷」按鈕"]
        UReadDialog["閱讀對話框警告文字"]
        UDecide{"確認撤銷?"}
        UClickConfirm["點擊「確認撤銷」"]
        UClickCancel["點擊「取消」/Esc"]
        USeesToast["看到 Toast「Token 已撤銷」"]
        USeeBadge["看到 Badge: Active → Revoked"]
        End(("結束（仍在 P01）"))
    end

    subgraph ClientApp["ClientApp (Razor + Alpine.js)"]
        OpenDialog["revokeConfirmModal.open(tokenId, prefix)"]
        Animate1["fade-in animation<br/>(150ms ease-out)"]
        Highlight["highlight 該 token 行"]
        SetIsLoading["isLoading = true<br/>disable buttons"]
        Animate2["spinner 顯示"]
        SendDelete["fetch DELETE /api/v1/me/tokens/{tokenId}<br/>X-CSRF + Idempotency-Key + Cookie"]
        DispatchToast["dispatchToast(success / error)"]
        UpdateBadgeAlpine["Alpine: tokens.find(id).status = 'Revoked'"]
        FadeOutDialog["dialog fade-out (200ms)"]
        ResetForm["clear dialog state"]
        Wait["等待 server response"]
    end

    subgraph Server["Server (ApiTokenBC)"]
        AuthMW{"Cookie + CSRF<br/>有效?"}
        Reject401(("401 Unauthorized"))
        AuthZ{"Token 擁有者 == 當前使用者<br/>OR isITAdmin?"}
        Reject403(("403 Forbidden<br/>{error: NOT_OWNER}"))
        FindToken{"Token 存在 + Active?"}
        Reject404(("404 Not Found"))
        Reject409(("409 Conflict<br/>{error: ALREADY_REVOKED}"))
        BeginTx[("BEGIN TRANSACTION")]
        UpdateStatus[("UPDATE api_tokens<br/>SET status='revoked',<br/>revoked_at=NOW(),<br/>revoked_by_user_id=$user")]
        WriteAudit[("INSERT token_audit_logs<br/>action='revoked'")]
        CommitTx[("COMMIT TX")]
        ReturnSuccess(("200 OK<br/>{tokenId, revokedAt}"))
    end

    UClick --> OpenDialog
    OpenDialog --> Animate1
    Animate1 --> Highlight
    Highlight --> UReadDialog
    UReadDialog --> UDecide
    UDecide -->|"否"| UClickCancel
    UClickCancel --> ResetForm
    ResetForm --> FadeOutDialog
    FadeOutDialog --> End

    UDecide -->|"是"| UClickConfirm
    UClickConfirm --> SetIsLoading
    SetIsLoading --> Animate2
    Animate2 --> SendDelete
    SendDelete --> Wait
    Wait --> AuthMW

    AuthMW -->|"否"| Reject401
    Reject401 --> ClientHandle401["Toast warning<br/>+ setTimeout 1.5s redirect /Login"]
    ClientHandle401 --> End

    AuthMW -->|"是"| AuthZ
    AuthZ -->|"否（非擁有者且非 IT Admin）"| Reject403
    Reject403 --> DispatchToast

    AuthZ -->|"是"| FindToken
    FindToken -->|"不存在"| Reject404
    FindToken -->|"已撤銷"| Reject409
    Reject404 --> DispatchToast
    Reject409 --> DispatchToast

    FindToken -->|"存在 + active"| BeginTx

    BeginTx -.->|"fork: 同 TX"| UpdateStatus
    BeginTx -.->|"fork: 同 TX"| WriteAudit
    UpdateStatus --> CommitTx
    WriteAudit --> CommitTx
    CommitTx --> ReturnSuccess
    ReturnSuccess --> UpdateBadgeAlpine
    UpdateBadgeAlpine --> DispatchToast
    DispatchToast --> FadeOutDialog
    FadeOutDialog --> USeesToast
    USeesToast --> USeeBadge
    USeeBadge --> End

    classDef userNode fill:#fff3cd,stroke:#ffc107,color:#000
    classDef clientNode fill:#cfe2ff,stroke:#0d6efd,color:#000
    classDef serverNode fill:#d1e7dd,stroke:#198754,color:#000
    classDef errorNode fill:#f8d7da,stroke:#dc3545,color:#000

    class UClick,UReadDialog,UDecide,UClickConfirm,UClickCancel,USeesToast,USeeBadge,End userNode
    class OpenDialog,Animate1,Highlight,SetIsLoading,Animate2,SendDelete,DispatchToast,UpdateBadgeAlpine,FadeOutDialog,ResetForm,Wait,ClientHandle401 clientNode
    class AuthMW,AuthZ,FindToken,BeginTx,UpdateStatus,WriteAudit,CommitTx,ReturnSuccess serverNode
    class Reject401,Reject403,Reject404,Reject409 errorNode
